Connect once and generate images, videos, characters, and audio from Claude or any MCP-compatible agent, without leaving your agent. The main difference from generating on the web: MCP always uses credits. Unlimited access and free generations apply only on <a href="https://higgsfield.ai/"><span style="text-decoration:underline">higgsfield.ai</span></a>, so anything generated through MCP, CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer, or other automated tools deducts credits at standard rates.</p><h2 id="what-is-higgsfield-mcp">What is Higgsfield MCP?</h2><p>MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open protocol that lets AI agents connect to external services and call their tools. Higgsfield MCP is a connector that lets you generate images, videos, characters, and audio from Higgsfield directly inside Claude or another MCP-compatible agent. It isn't a separate product or API: it connects to your existing account and uses your existing plan credits, with no API key required.</p><p>Because MCP connects programmatically, using Higgsfield through it falls under the Developer Terms in the <a href="https://higgsfield.ai/terms-of-use-agreement"><span style="text-decoration:underline">Terms of Use</span></a>. In short: keep your connection secure, and you're responsible for anything an agent generates through your account.</p><p><strong>MCP server URL: </strong><a href="https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp" rel="nofollow"><code><span style="text-decoration:underline">https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp</span></code></a></p><h2 id="how-is-mcp-different-from-the-web">How is MCP different from the web?</h2><p>The most important difference is credit behavior: everything generated through MCP deducts credits, regardless of your plan.</p><table><caption class="sr-only">How is MCP different from the web?</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col"><p>Criteria</p></th><th scope="col"><p><strong>Web (<a href="http://higgsfield.ai"><span style="text-decoration:underline">higgsfield.ai</span></a>)</strong></p></th><th scope="col"><p><strong>MCP</strong></p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><p><strong>Unlimited model access</strong></p></td><td><p>Yes, where included in plan</p></td><td><p>No, always deducts credits</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Free generations</strong></p></td><td><p>Yes, where included in plan</p></td><td><p>No</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Credit cost</strong></p></td><td><p>Standard rates</p></td><td><p>Standard rates</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Generations appear in Assets</strong></p></td><td><p>Yes</p></td><td><p>Yes</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Access to models</strong></p></td><td><p>Yes</p></td><td><p>Yes</p></td></tr></tbody></table><h2 id="do-unlimited-models-and-free-generations-work-through-mcp">Do Unlimited models and free generations work through MCP?</h2><p>No. Unlimited access and free generations apply only on <a href="https://higgsfield.ai/"><span style="text-decoration:underline">higgsfield.ai</span></a>: they're intended for manual use, not for automated or programmatic generation. Anything generated through MCP, CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer, or other automated tools deducts credits at standard rates. To generate on a model where your plan includes Unlimited access without spending credits, do it on the web at <a href="https://higgsfield.ai/"><span style="text-decoration:underline">higgsfield.ai</span></a>.</p><h2 id="what-can-i-do-through-mcp">What can I do through MCP?</h2><p>Image and video generation, Soul character use, Higgsfield Audio, and credit balance checks. For the full list of operations and how to phrase requests to your agent, see <a href="https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/integrations/how-do-i-connect-higgsfield-to-ai-agent"><span style="text-decoration:underline">How do I connect Higgsfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI agent?</span></a></p></div></div><section class="w-full flex flex-col gap-6 p-6 rounded-xl bg-surface-primary mt-16"><h2 class="font-grotesk text-2xl leading-7 font-bold uppercase tracking-[-1.2px] text-white">Got any questions left?</h2><div class="flex flex-col"><div class="w-full"><button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="_R_paalcjaqt8q_" class="flex w-full gap-2 items-center py-2 text-left cursor-pointer"><span class="flex-1 min-w-0 text-base font-semibold leading-6 text-white">Do I need a separate API key to use Higgsfield MCP?</span><span class="flex items-center justify-center size-6 shrink-0 text-white"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" class="size-5"><path d="M8 3.5V8M8 8V12.5M8 8H3.5M8 8H12.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="1.5"></path></svg></span></button><div id="_R_paalcjaqt8q_" class="grid transition-[grid-template-rows] duration-300 ease-in-out grid-rows-[0fr]"><div class="overflow-hidden"><div class="pt-1 pb-4 text-base leading-6 text-font-secondary whitespace-pre-line"><p>No. MCP connects through OAuth authorization, no API key is needed.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="w-full"><button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="_R_19aalcjaqt8q_" class="flex w-full gap-2 items-center py-2 text-left cursor-pointer"><span class="flex-1 min-w-0 text-base font-semibold leading-6 text-white">I have Unlimited access to a model, but MCP charged credits for it.
